fields.name: Shard id
fields.definition: The 16-bit integer (`short`) that identifies one shard within its shard set and forms the shard part of every shard key. The shard id is assigned by client configuration. The shard database does not itself know its id unless the application tells it, so every client must agree on the shard id-to-database mapping; a mismatch silently directs reads and writes to the wrong database.
